name: SignNow
description: SignNow prepares, routes, and tracks electronic-signature documents.
agentUseSummary: Connect one SignNow user through Relay-owned confidential OAuth. SignNow authorizes with the broad * scope, so Relay contains the token server-side and exposes only two fixed, read-only projections: up to 25 first-page document metadata summaries and lifecycle metadata for one explicit document. People, content, signing, audit data, writes, broader authority, raw paths, arbitrary queries, pagination, polling, retries, and exports are blocked.

capabilities.label: List documents
capabilities.description: Read a bounded first page of self-owned document metadata.

capabilities.label: Inspect document metadata
capabilities.description: Read lifecycle metadata for one explicit document.

allowed.label: List document summaries
allowed.description: List up to 25 first-page document metadata summaries owned by the connected user.

allowed.label: Inspect a document
allowed.description: Inspect lifecycle metadata for one explicit SignNow document ID.

blocked.label: Access private document content
blocked.description: Files, downloads, thumbnails, page images, fields, filled values, signer and recipient identity, signatures, invitations, messages, attachments, and audit data are blocked.

blocked.label: Mutate or sign documents
blocked.description: Uploading, creating, editing, sending, signing, sharing, reminding, cancelling, deleting, and generating signing links are blocked.

blocked.label: Use broad provider authority
blocked.description: Templates, document groups, teams, organizations, users, webhooks, embedded signing, account administration, and every other capability conveyed by SignNow's broad OAuth token are blocked.

blocked.label: Use raw or bulk APIs
blocked.description: Raw paths, arbitrary queries, pagination, polling, automatic retries, batch access, and exports are blocked.

approvalProfiles.label: Read-only document metadata
approvalProfiles.description: Two bounded metadata reads run automatically; SignNow's broad token is contained behind fixed paths, strict projection, and blocked writes.

approvalProfiles.label: Dangerously skip permissions
approvalProfiles.description: Fixed paths, strict field projection, the result cap, and Relay's read-only boundary remain enforced despite the provider's broad token.

runtimeSupport.description: Relay mounts two bounded metadata reads and keeps the broad SignNow OAuth token server-side behind fixed GET routes and strict projection.
Relay mounts two bounded metadata reads and keeps the broad SignNow OAuth token server-side behind fixed GET routes and strict projection.

providerSetup.blocker: Relay's SignNow OAuth application, production API plan, client credentials, and any required provider approval are not configured. SignNow exposes broad * authority rather than a documented fine-grained read-only scope. No provider-console, credential, consent, Railway, or live acceptance work is authorized in this worker task.
providerSetup.nextAction: An authorized owner configures the exact Railway callback on a Relay-owned SignNow OAuth application, stores the client ID and secret through Railway's secret process, completes any provider review, deploys separately, and runs live connect, user binding, list/get redaction, refresh, local disconnect, and post-disconnect denial acceptance.

evidence.supports: SignNow documents OAuth 2.0, authorization_code for other user accounts, refresh_token, Basic client credentials, and POST /oauth2/token.
SignNow documents the browser redirect used to obtain an authorization code.
SignNow's official SDK documents form-encoded Basic-auth token and refresh exchanges and access-token responses containing refresh token, expiry, and scope.
SignNow's official SDK documents GET /user/documentsv2 and GET /document/{id}; Relay fixes those paths and projects only metadata.
